name: PT Agung Menjangan Mas Tbk
summary: PT Agung Menjangan Mas Tbk is an Indonesian company dedicated to supporting the country's aquaculture and shrimp farming industries. It offers a comprehensive range of services for shrimp cultivation, encompassing initial pond preparation, ongoing maintenance and oversight throughout the growing cycle, assistance during the harvesting phase, and post-harvest readiness. Additionally, the company diversifies its revenue by leasing out its commercial land and office spaces. Founded in 2004, PT Agung Menjangan Mas Tbk's main office is located in South Jakarta, Indonesia, and it functions as a division of PT Mandara Mas Semesta.
